Counting cut incidences in all 32 triangles proves 2 C_2+C_1<=64, square-edge incidence C_1<=2q and degree five C<=5q, hence C<=min(32+q,5q). This inequality proves an all-real-field lower envelope whose minima are at q=0,8,12; certified attaining configurations establish equality. Exact 7^6 enumeration yields the complete first-critical q counts 3,24,84,72,18 and ground zero 18, and independently all 2^24 configurations are enumerated via Gray code with matching maximum-cut counts. The proof quantifies field and spins without extrapolation.

value.rationale: A uniform longitudinal field is a natural controlled perturbation of geometric antiferromagnetic frustration. The proof yields a complete exact finite-system magnetic response, with a sharp 0-to-one-third plateau jump, a second saturation threshold, and a nontrivial magnetization-resolved 201-state boundary, rather than a routine independence-polynomial corollary. The six-square decomposition is a reusable structural explanation for the sharp envelope.
